title: Evaluating the Simulation of Human Personality-Driven Susceptibility to Misinformation with LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Conditioning LLM agents with Big-Five personality profiles (Open Mindedness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Negative Emotionality), prompting them to rate the accuracy of true and false news headlines, and comparing the resulting trait-discernment correlations against human benchmark data to detect systematic model distortions.

Analyzing the divergence between simulated agent behavior and human baselines to identify model tendencies to over-represent socially desirable traits (such as increased Extraversion and reduced Negative Emotionality) in their news discernment judgments.
